reviews.title: Shady operating model - Do not purchase anything from them.
reviews.text: I received an invitation to purchase some wine at a good price.  I agreed.  They needed to verify my age.  Can only do that by following the link which makes you open an account.  I then closed this account within the three day free membership period but they still debited me yesterday.  I cannot apply for the ‘no quibble refund’ because I originally joined over three days ago even though I didn’t know they would incorrectly debit me yesterday. This is a trap.

reviews.title: Misleading Interface, unauthorized charges , and no way to delete your payment details
reviews.text: I strongly advise caution when using this app. While exploring the app and trying the spinning game, the interface triggered two separate purchases that I never agreed to or confirmed. When I reached out to customer service straightaway to cancel the accidental orders, they simply refused. To make matters worse there is no option anywhere in the profile setting to remove your credit card details, which raise serious concerns about data privacy and consumer rights. Using gamified features to push accidental charges combined with trapping consumer payment consumer data payment is a terrible user experience. Please think twice before putting your credit card details.

reviews.title: WARNING: Charges you instantly without a checkout!
reviews.text:
Do not add your card details to this app! They use a highly deceptive interface that does not have a normal shopping basket. The exact second you tap to "add" a bottle to your case to check the total price, your card is charged immediately. There is no checkout screen, no final total to review, and no payment confirmation.

I was charged over £350 in the space of 10 minutes just by browsing and adding items to what I thought was a standard basket. On top of this, adding your card automatically signs you up for a paid annual membership subscription that is very poorly communicated. A completely misleading app design. Avoid this unless you want a massive surprise on your bank statement.

reviews.title: Poor
reviews.text:
Dry disappointed with this site. Yes, they show good discounts, but at the cheaper end the discounts don’t really top those you can get with a club card for example (other supermarket cards available). So when you add in the £119 to join it takes a lot of buying to start to make a profit. I decided to leave so they gave me 2 bottles to stay. However,
 2 other bottles put on the order to get the free ones weren’t delivered. No credit back of payment or store credit and no response when I complained. And I now can’t leave until September because I accepted the 2 bottles so expect I’ll be charged another years membership before I get the chance to leave!
Very poor customer service.

reviews.title: Cheap wine BUT misleading
reviews.text:
Be aware there is a £119 annual subscription fee which isn’t made clear until it’s debited from your account - without notice or a confirmation email (they confirm everything else, why not the membership charge!) - in fairness they refunded the £119 fee as I challenged within their 48 hour grace period but had I not been checking my CC and missed their (made up) grace period timeline I’d have been fuming. Obviously a hot topic for them as the replies are all templated and clearly regularly issued to disgruntled customers. 

On a side note the 6 bottles I did order arrived on time, well packaged and are significantly cheaper - if you’re spending more than £40 a month on wine this could be good value but they should make the subscription model clearer.
